proposed_capability: Track one stable owned Get Famous drone per actor, detect stream end, recover via verified native interactions, and plan per-Sim Fame perks and training.
player_save_control_impact: Reuse game-native paired idle probes, protected save admission, actor ownership, and atomic dispatch. Vision and EA files can inform discovery only. No off-lot screen input or new game loop.
expected_outcome: Record same-device stream end; guard departure; return an owned public-ground drone through a verified reachable home route; reobserve the same item in personal inventory; respect each Sim’s spotlight choice and perk prerequisites.
negative_tests: Airborne/grounded, favorite, followers, and EA file snapshots cannot prove a current stream transition.
Unknown owner, absent actor, stale route and missing spotlight participation abstain.
No blind retry after unknown submit or cross-Sim outcome.
rollback_path: Revert isolated feature PR or omit the optional Fairy Dust support from the independently built installed ecology package.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build runtime object, actor/zone and affordance IDs and gameplay trial under issue #171.
